_about: Hand-set prices and age-up costs for the investment analysis. Every result row stores a fingerprint of this file.

freeUnitPrices: total listed cost to use for a unit whose matched variation costs nothing. Without an entry, a free unit is priced at the paid variation of the same unit (its regular counterpart), and only when there is none is it counted at 0 and flagged.

ageUpDefaults: the divisor used when the age-up the player bought can't be found in the build order (the row is flagged). Normally the divisor is the listed cost of the landmark or age-up technology they actually bought, so the Ayyubid Advancement wing's 300, 1350 and 2050 apply by themselves.
Prices for militia-halberdier, shinobi and rus-tribute agreed by Andrei 21 Nov 2026; the rest come from the Sheet's notes.
